title: iTutorGroup to Pay $365000 to Settle EEOC Discriminatory Hiring Suit
supports_claim: EEOC said the company would pay $365000 and that software auto-rejected more than 200 older applicants.
limitations: This is a settlement write-up. It does not include a public model audit.

title: Navigating Employment Discrimination in AI and Automated Systems - Testimony of Gary D. Friedman
supports_claim: Testimony retells the Amazon recruiting-tool story and warns iTutorGroup may have been programmed rules not AI.
limitations: This is witness testimony not an EEOC court finding. Amazon details come from other reporting.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
supports_claim: NIST says teams should govern map measure and manage AI risk including monitoring and residual risk.
limitations: Voluntary guide. It is not a legal label or a certificate.

title: Law 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: Vietnam AI Law took effect on 2026-03-01 and is the main AI law to check.
limitations: I cannot tell our exact duties from the title. Need legal to map our workflow.

title: Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg high-risk AI list
supports_claim: Vietnam published a high-risk AI list that took effect on 2026-08-15.
limitations: We still have to match our live product to the full list. I did not do that mapping.

title: EU AI Act implementation timeline
supports_claim: The Commission page treats employment including recruitment as a high-risk area and shows a staged timeline.
limitations: Dates can change. Recheck before any EU launch.

title: Law 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection
supports_claim: Candidate name contact and work history are personal data under Vietnam PDPL when we process applications.
limitations: Lawful basis vendor roles and notices still need a privacy owner and legal. I only flagged the issue.

title: Collision Between Vehicle Controlled by Developmental Automated Driving System and Pedestrian NTSB HWY18MH010
supports_claim: NTSB shows a serious failure can start in oversight and process not only in the model score.
limitations: Different industry. I use it only for the group pattern about weak human oversight.

title: External Validation of a Widely Implemented Proprietary Sepsis Prediction Model in Hospitalized Patients
supports_claim: A deployed hospital model did much worse than the vendor-reported score in an external check.
limitations: Healthcare not hiring. I use it only to remember not to trust vendor metrics alone.
